name: Hard Voxelization with Capacity Limits
aliases: Amount of Points Spawned per Voxel
Amount of Points Spawned per Voxel ($p_{max}$)
definition: Inserts 3D points into a voxel grid, enforcing a maximum points-per-voxel limit, marking chunks as modified, and handling out-of-window or invalid points.
summary: Hard Voxelization with Capacity Limits converts 3D points to a fixed voxel grid while enforcing strict limits on points per voxel and total voxels via rejection counters.
